projects.title: Events & Venue Booking System
features: Followed full Software Design & Architecture (SDA) process from concept to deployment.
Created complete UML diagrams including Use Cases, Class, SSD, and Sequence diagrams in draw.io.
Built interactive desktop application using Java, JavaFX, and modern UI styles.
Integrated SQL Server database system for persistent records and booking transactions.

projects.title: Network Design & Simulation
features: Designed and simulated a multi-layer enterprise network topology in Cisco Packet Tracer.
Configured dynamic routing protocols including OSPF, EIGRP, and RIP for packet routing.
Applied VLSM subnetting, DHCP services, NAT routing, and Access Control Lists (ACLs).
Validated end-to-end connectivity, traffic flow, and security rules across all subnets.

projects.title: Multi-Game Console System
features: Developed a modular console application supporting Snake, Hangman, and Wordle.
Designed a custom Object-Oriented C++ framework to isolate individual game logic.
Created a shared game loop controlling frame updates, direct input, and render logic.
Integrated centralized scoring, state management, and win/loss condition tracking.

projects.title: Zuma Deluxe Clone
features: Programmed a complete Zuma clone in low-level x86 Assembly language.
Engineered a low-level rendering loop using CPU registers and direct memory operations.
Implemented real-time keyboard polling, movement mechanics, and physics calculations.
Created color-matching collision algorithms and cascading chain-reaction explosions.

projects.title: Centipede Arcade Game
features: Recreated the classic Centipede arcade game using structured programming in C++.
Utilized SFML (Simple and Fast Multimedia Library) for sprite rendering, audio, and window management.
Built core game mechanics: player fire controls, centipede segmentation, and mushroom grids.
Structured logic with functions, arrays, and pointer manipulation to ensure smooth execution.

projects.title: OS-Based Game Engine
features: Constructed a multi-process game framework applying core Operating System principles.
Leveraged multithreading and concurrency tools to handle player actions, AI, and graphics.
Implemented CPU scheduling algorithms to balance workloads across processor threads.
Managed resource sync using Mutex locks and semaphores to eliminate race conditions.

projects.title: Hospital Database System
features: Architected a comprehensive hospital database layout using ER/EER model designs.
Normalized schemas up to 3NF/BCNF in SQL Server to ensure zero data redundancy.
Developed PHP backend server forms and dynamic reporting scripts for front-end access.
Configured local XAMPP environments to test query responses, views, and integrity constraints.
